title: Clockwork Sorcerer
description: A purple-haired young man in a black and purple trench coat stands centered with arms outstretched, a large blue dragon coiled around his body and shoulders. Behind him is a giant ornate clock face floating in a cosmic sky filled with swirling clouds, glowing scarab beetles with clock faces for bodies, and a hooded skeletal Grim Reaper figure on the right holding a pocket watch.
prompt: A dramatic surreal fantasy scene featuring a young man with vibrant purple hair wearing a black and purple long coat standing with arms spread wide. A large vibrant blue dragon is coiled around his torso and shoulders, its head raised above him. Behind them floats a giant ornate clock face with Roman numerals against a swirling cosmic nebula background. Multiple glowing metallic scarab beetles with clock faces on their backs fly around the scene. On the right, a hooded purple Grim Reaper holds a small pocket watch. Dynamic composition, rich colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
